'''[[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]''' did not repeat its successful season in 1999–2000, and fell back to second in [[La Liga]], as well as knocked out of the Champions League in the semi-finals.

Barcelona did not perform well in the mid season and lost the league title to [[Deportivo La Coruña]] just 5 points behind and [[Louis van Gaal]] was let go by the club, with former [[Real Betis]] coach [[Lorenzo Serra Ferrer]] taking over after 1999–2000 season.

Despite the trophyless season, the side managed to reach the semi-finals of the [[UEFA Champions League]], where it lost to eventual competition runners up [[Valencia CF|Valencia]].
